test_tolist_scalar_dtype: test the Series.tolist method preserves scalar Python types across int64, float64, string, interval, period, timedelta, and datetime dtypes
test_tolist_int_dtype: test Series.tolist returns Python int for int64 and Int64 nullable integer dtypes
test_tolist_float_dtype: test Series.tolist returns Python float for float64 and Float64 nullable float dtypes
test_tolist_string_dtype: test Series.tolist returns Python str for object and string dtypes
test_tolist_arrow_dtype: test Series.tolist returns correct scalar types for pyarrow-backed int64, float64, and string dtypes
